text:
sara: quick sync  we need one canonical plan for the policy gateway + bundle semantics for canary/fallbacks.
liam: agree. two big axes: where decisions execute (central vs local) and how much autonomy runtimes get when controller is flaky.
neha: i'd prefer hybrid: controller publishes small, signed bundles; runtimes evaluate with local telemetry. keep controller authoritative but not critical.
sara: exactly. bundle must include: id, version, created_at, grace_mode, max_stale_s, policies[], probe_specs[], signature.
liam: propose grace_mode values: "allow" (continue routing to candidate), "deny" (stop candidate), "safe-pass" (route to baseline but keep sampling). keep default = safe-pass.
neha: also include an explicit "override_allowlist" for emergency ops to bypass some checks per-tenant. must be auditable.
sara: ops-bot: note - we need key rotation plan for bundle signing (KMS/HSM).
ops-bot: logged: "bundle-signing-rotation" ticket created #INC-421.
liam: probe model: controller can request lightweight liveness/quality probes from runtimes against candidate variant. probes return pass/fail + minimal metrics (latency p50/p95, error_rate). sampling controlled by probe_specs.
neha: runtime local heuristics: if candidate error_rate > E or p95 > L for M requests, immediate local divert. these thresholds are set in bundle but runtime may enforce stricter tenant-level limits.
sara: telemetry contract: aggregated per-10s envelopes with {variant, sample_rate, p50, p95, errors, requests}. do not stream raw traces unless sampled.
liam: decision API sketch: CheckFallback(request_id, bundle_version, variant, context) -> {action, reason, debug_id}. action in [ROUTE, FALLBACK, PROBE]. keep it sync/fast.
neha: when controller overloaded, runtime should use backpressure rule: if controller_qdepth > Q or > latency SLO, runtimes switch to local fallback rules automatically. document this for private deploys too.
sara: incident flow: 1) controller detects regression -> quick rollback bundle 2) controller pushes bundle with grace_mode=deny 3) runtimes apply and divert 4) notify owners + attach sampled decision traces.
liam: add diagnostics endpoint on runtime: /_policy_trace?request_id=XXX returns sampled decision steps and bundle_version. controllers can fetch for debugging. keep traces to 1% sampling.
neha: long-term: produce a tiny policy-gateway lib for runtimes (bundle manager, verifier, probe scheduler, fallback evaluator). runtimes call gateway.check(variant, ctx) only. simplifies integration.
sara: good. compatibility note: private deployments might disable remote decisions; add "disable_remote_decisions" flag in bundle and runtime config honors it.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: published bundle v1.2.0 to staging clusters 5m ago.
sara: next actions: liam/ neha write bundle proto + minimal JSON schema; ops to draft KMS rotation; i'll start RFC for policy-gateway lib.
liam: i'll mock-check failure modes and unit tests for stale bundle TTL.
neha: i'll run chaos test where controller is slow and validate grace_mode transitions in staging.
sara: cheers. keeping this thread as canonical notes for the RFC follow-up. :thumbsup:
